title: VeriDark: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Authorship Verification on the Dark Web
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It is designed for authorship verification and identification on Dark Web data. Religion is mentioned only in the ethical considerations section as a type of sensitive data that might be present and as a basis for discrimination that is explicitly forbidden as a use case for the dataset.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its analysis is focused on the performance of authorship verification models in a cybersecurity context.
